messages:
maria_ng: Quick recap from today's Brightline security review. They want short answers on audit log retention/export, KMS BYOK & rotation, RBAC change approvals, and incident response evidence. Need a one‑page Q&A by EOD. Can people drop bullets and links here?

ton y_w: Audit logs: default retention = 90 days on our hosted offering; enterprise customers can request extended retention up to 365 days. We can export raw audit streams to a customer-owned S3/GCS bucket over a VPC endpoint. Sample config we usually provide: 

```
audit:
  retention_days: 365
  export:
    enabled: true
    s3_bucket: "s3://brightline-audit"
    vpc_endpoint: "vpce-0abc123def"
```

Also note we sign logs with SHA256 and include per-request request_id and user_id fields for traceability.

jess_li: BYOK flow: Brightline can supply a CMK in their cloud KMS (or HSM). We support: 1) customer-managed CMK (Redwood never sees raw key material), 2) Redwood envelope encryption with customer KEK, or 3) on-prem HSM integration for Private. For cloud-KMS example, they need to grant our service role decrypt/encrypt permissions. Example IAM policy (minimal):

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service-role"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:987654321098:key/abcd-ef01"
    }
  ]
}
```

We should give Brightline the exact role ARN and a short checklist for key rotation and disablement.

leah_ops: RBAC change process we propose for enterprise customers:
- Submit change as an "RBAC change" ticket in infra-catalog (template + owner + rollout window)
- Security tag required on tickets touching prod roles
- Two approvers from infra/sec for changes that grant write/admin privileges
- Changes are applied to canary namespace, smoke tests run (5 min), then staged rollout
- System creates an immutable audit record linking PR/ticket/approver IDs

We already emit an audit event for every role/grant change with fields: actor, change_id, before, after, ticket_url.

audits-bot: Automated note: We store audit exports in our encrypted audit-bucket (SSE-KMS). Export delivery status for brightline-audit: success (timestamp: 2026-11-02T18:34:12Z). Link: https://console.redwood.dev/audit-exports/brightline-audit

kms-bot: Upcoming CMK rotation scheduled for brightline-cmk (id: key-0f1e2d3c) on 2026-09-03T02:00:00Z. Rotation mode: customer-managed notify.

maria_ng: For incident response evidence, Brightline asked for proof of tabletop runs and mean time to detect/contain. We keep tabletop records + postmortem templates. Short answer: we run quarterly table tops for enterprise customers + annual external incident simulation on request. We can provide a redacted example report and a signed attestation.

tony_w: I'll draft the audit & export Qs and include the export config + link to the S3/VPC walkthrough.

jess_li: I'll draft the KMS/BYOK Qs and include the IAM policy snippet and rotation checklist.

leah_ops: I'll take RBAC change process + incident evidence section. Will add the exact audit event schema.
